subject: math
description: Construct segments, angles, triangles, secondary parts, and triangle centers, then justify each construction using congruence ideas.
learningObjectives: Copy a segment and an angle accurately using construction tools
Construct triangles from given side and angle information
Construct perpendicular bisectors, angle bisectors, medians, and altitudes
Locate triangle centers from intersecting secondary parts
Justify construction steps using congruent segments, congruent angles, and triangle congruence ideas
Identify and correct common construction errors
prerequisites: Use a ruler, straightedge, compass, and protractor carefully
Recognize congruent segments and congruent angles in diagrams
Name perpendicular, parallel, midpoint, and angle bisector relationships
Apply basic triangle congruence ideas such as SSS and SAS
